_comment: Fictieve casus Stichting Zorggroep Waterlinie (VVT-zorgaanbieder). Risicoteksten zijn in het Engels omdat de blueprint- en signaalwoorden in rcm_builder.py Engels zijn. Elk item heeft een objective dat letterlijk overeenkomt met een business_objective onder processes, anders krijgt het risico geen OBJ-id. Het veld observation is vrije context en wordt door de pipeline genegeerd.

risk_appetite.financial: Cautious: a material misstatement in the annual accounts or in declarations to insurers is not acceptable
risk_appetite.operational: Moderate: temporary disruption of supporting processes is acceptable as long as care continuity is safeguarded
risk_appetite.compliance: Low tolerance for privacy breaches involving client data
risk_appetite.it: Moderate: the ECD and ERP must be reliable and traceable; short planned downtime is acceptable

processes.description: Registratie van geleverde zorg in het ECD (ZorgDossier), declaratie aan zorgverzekeraars en zorgkantoor (Wlz, Zvw, Wmo), journaalposten en maandafsluiting in het ERP (FinCore).

business_objectives.objective_description: Care delivered is completely and accurately declared to health insurers and the care office in the correct period
Declared care is supported by a valid indication and the client's care plan
Only care that has actually been delivered is declared
Journal entries are authorised, supported and recorded in the correct period
Management override of journal entry controls is prevented and detected
The month-end close is completed timely with reconciled ledger balances

processes.description: Leveranciersbeheer, inkoop van hulpmiddelen, voeding en facilitaire diensten, factuurverwerking in FinCore en betaling via het bankportaal.

business_objectives.objective_description: Vendors are legitimate and changes to vendor master data are independently approved
Invoices are approved by an authorised mandate holder before payment
Payments are made only for goods and services actually received

processes.description: Salarisverwerking van circa 2.800 fte via de externe salarisprovider LoonLink, gevoed vanuit de roosterapplicatie PlanWijs.

business_objectives.objective_description: Salary payments are accurate and based on reconciled hours
Salary payments are made to current employees only
Remuneration of executives and interim managers complies with the WNT
Leave and absence are recorded completely and timely

processes.description: Toegang tot clientdossiers in ZorgDossier via het IAM-portaal IdentiteitsHub, verwerking en bescherming van clientgegevens (AVG, NEN 7510).

business_objectives.objective_description: Only authorised care staff have user access to client records in the ECD, limited to the clients in their care
Use of client records in the ECD is logged and monitored
Client data is protected against loss and unauthorised disclosure (GDPR art. 32, NEN 7510)
Client data is processed and shared with third parties on a lawful basis

processes.description: Wijzigingen aan ZorgDossier (ECD) en FinCore (ERP) via de servicedesktool ChangeFlow, inclusief releases, noodwijzigingen en configuratie van koppelingen.

business_objectives.objective_description: Changes to the ECD and ERP are tested and approved before release to production
Production configuration is changed only through the change process

historical_risks.objective: Journal entries are authorised, supported and recorded in the correct period
historical_risks.cause: manual journal entries above EUR 50,000 are posted in the ERP without documented supervisor approval
historical_risks.event: unsupported or unauthorised journal entries are recorded in the general ledger
historical_risks.impact: the annual accounts contain a material misstatement
historical_risks.observation: Internal audit 2024: 9 of 25 sampled manual journal entries above EUR 50,000 had no approval evidence.

historical_risks.objective: Only authorised care staff have user access to client records in the ECD, limited to the clients in their care
historical_risks.cause: no periodic review of user accounts and access rights in the ECD is performed
historical_risks.event: former or transferred employees retain user access to client records
historical_risks.impact: client data is viewed by unauthorised users and a privacy breach must be reported
historical_risks.observation: Internal audit 2024: 112 active ECD user accounts belonged to employees who had left more than 30 days earlier.

historical_risks.objective: Vendors are legitimate and changes to vendor master data are independently approved
historical_risks.cause: vendor bank account details in the ERP can be changed and approved by the same accounts payable employee
historical_risks.event: vendor bank account details are changed without independent approval
historical_risks.impact: payments are diverted to an unauthorized bank account and cash is misappropriated
historical_risks.observation: Internal audit 2025: the FinCore role 'AP clerk' includes both maintain and approve rights on vendor master data.

historical_risks.objective: Salary payments are accurate and based on reconciled hours
historical_risks.cause: hours from the roster application are interfaced to the payroll provider without reconciliation
historical_risks.event: salary payments to employee bank accounts are based on incomplete or incorrect hours
historical_risks.impact: employees are overpaid or underpaid, and payroll cash outflow and expense are misstated
historical_risks.observation: Internal audit 2025: no reconciliation between PlanWijs roster totals and LoonLink payroll input is retained.

historical_risks.objective: Changes to the ECD and ERP are tested and approved before release to production
historical_risks.cause: emergency changes to the ERP are deployed to production without testing or retrospective approval
historical_risks.event: untested changes cause processing errors in the billing and ledger interfaces
historical_risks.impact: declarations and ledger balances are incorrect and the financial close is delayed
historical_risks.observation: Internal audit 2025: 7 of 11 emergency changes to FinCore lacked a retrospective change record.

historical_risks.objective: The month-end close is completed timely with reconciled ledger balances
historical_risks.risk_description: Absence of a documented month-end close checklist may result in ledger reconciliations being skipped leading to unreconciled balances in the annual accounts.
historical_risks.observation: Internal audit 2025: the close is managed from personal to-do lists of two controllers; no checklist or sign-off exists. Dit item staat bewust als lopende zin (risk_description) om de tekstparser te tonen.

historical_risks.objective: Declared care is supported by a valid indication and the client's care plan
historical_risks.cause: care registrations in the ECD application are not validated against the client's care plan and indication before the declaration report is sent through the insurer interface
historical_risks.event: care is declared that deviates from the indicated care
historical_risks.impact: insurers claw back revenue and the organisation faces repeated corrections
historical_risks.observation: Internal audit 2023: EUR 1.4 million of declarations corrected after insurer material controls; finding repeated in 2024.

incidents.objective: Only authorised care staff have user access to client records in the ECD, limited to the clients in their care
incidents.cause: user accounts and access rights in the ECD are not periodically reviewed
incidents.event: former and transferred employees retain user access to client records
incidents.impact: client data is viewed by unauthorised users and a privacy breach has to be reported
incidents.observation: A home-care employee who left in March 2025 opened 14 client records in June 2025 using her still-active ECD account. Bewust gelijkend op F-2024-07: wordt samengevoegd.

incidents.objective: Invoices are approved by an authorised mandate holder before payment
incidents.cause: invoice approval limits in the ERP workflow were not updated after the reorganisation of the facility department
incidents.event: invoices are approved by employees without a valid mandate
incidents.impact: payments are made for goods and services that were not properly authorised
incidents.observation: EUR 86,000 of facility invoices approved by a team lead whose mandate ended with the reorganisation.

incidents.objective: Changes to the ECD and ERP are tested and approved before release to production
incidents.cause: a new release of the ECD was deployed to production on a Friday without regression testing
incidents.event: care staff cannot record care activities during a two-day outage
incidents.impact: care registration is incomplete and declarations to insurers are delayed
incidents.observation: ZorgDossier release 8.4 broke the mobile app; 1,900 care workers registered on paper for two days.

incidents.objective: Client data is protected against loss and unauthorised disclosure (GDPR art. 32, NEN 7510)
incidents.cause: client reports are exported from the ECD to unencrypted USB devices and personal email
incidents.event: client data is lost or disclosed outside the organisation
incidents.impact: a personal data breach must be reported to the Dutch DPA and a fine may be imposed
incidents.observation: A USB stick with 230 client reports was left in a taxi; reported to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens on 12 January 2026.

incidents.objective: Salary payments are accurate and based on reconciled hours
incidents.cause: hours from the roster application are sent to the payroll provider without a reconciliation
incidents.event: salary payments to employee bank accounts are calculated on incomplete or incorrect hours
incidents.impact: employees are overpaid or underpaid, and the payroll cash outflow and expense are misstated
incidents.observation: December 2025 payroll run: 41 employees underpaid because roster corrections were not transferred to LoonLink. Bewust gelijkend op F-2025-05: wordt samengevoegd.

incidents.objective: Care delivered is completely and accurately declared to health insurers and the care office in the correct period
incidents.cause: the monthly declaration batch is sent to the insurers manually at month-end close without a deadline check
incidents.event: declarations are submitted after the insurer's submission deadline
incidents.impact: revenue is recognised in the wrong period in the ledger and cash receipts are delayed
incidents.observation: Insurer rejected 3.2% of January 2026 home-care declarations as late; the revenue was booked in February.

incidents.objective: Production configuration is changed only through the change process
incidents.risk_description: Configuration changes to the ERP billing interface made directly in production could lead to declaration files being rejected by the insurers resulting in delayed revenue and cash receipts.
incidents.observation: A field mapping in the FinCore declaration interface was changed in production; two weeks of declaration files rejected by Vecozo. Dit item staat bewust als lopende zin (risk_description) om de tekstparser te tonen.

fraud_scenarios.objective: Vendors are legitimate and changes to vendor master data are independently approved
fraud_scenarios.cause: an accounts payable employee can change and approve vendor bank account details in the ERP alone
fraud_scenarios.event: vendor bank account details are changed without independent approval to a fictitious vendor
fraud_scenarios.impact: payments are diverted to an unauthorized bank account and cash is misappropriated
fraud_scenarios.observation: Fraud risk workshop 2026, scenario 1: vendor master data manipulation (asset misappropriation). Bewust gelijkend op F-2025-02: wordt samengevoegd.

fraud_scenarios.objective: Management override of journal entry controls is prevented and detected
fraud_scenarios.cause: management can override the journal entry approval workflow at period end
fraud_scenarios.event: revenue is inflated through manual top-side journal entries
fraud_scenarios.impact: the annual accounts are materially misstated to meet financial targets
fraud_scenarios.observation: Fraud risk workshop 2026, scenario 2: management override of controls (fraudulent financial reporting).

fraud_scenarios.objective: Salary payments are made to current employees only
fraud_scenarios.cause: leavers are not removed from the payroll master data timely and payroll master data changes are not independently reviewed
fraud_scenarios.event: salary payments continue to former employees or fictitious ghost employees
fraud_scenarios.impact: cash is misappropriated through the payroll
fraud_scenarios.observation: Fraud risk workshop 2026, scenario 3: ghost employees.

fraud_scenarios.objective: Only care that has actually been delivered is declared
fraud_scenarios.cause: care registration can be entered and approved in the ECD by the same care worker without independent verification (fraud risk)
fraud_scenarios.event: care hours that were never delivered are declared through falsified registrations
fraud_scenarios.impact: insurers are billed for fictitious care, a misappropriation of care funds that triggers claw-backs and fines
fraud_scenarios.observation: Fraud risk workshop 2026, scenario 4: fictitious care declarations (upcoding / phantom billing).

fraud_scenarios.objective: Payments are made only for goods and services actually received
fraud_scenarios.cause: purchase invoices below the approval threshold are not matched to purchase orders or goods receipts
fraud_scenarios.event: an employee submits fictitious invoices split below the threshold in collusion with a vendor
fraud_scenarios.impact: cash is misappropriated through fictitious purchases
fraud_scenarios.observation: Fraud risk workshop 2026, scenario 5: invoice splitting and vendor collusion.

regulatory_risks.objective: Client data is protected against loss and unauthorised disclosure (GDPR art. 32, NEN 7510)
regulatory_risks.cause: client data exported from the ECD to USB devices and personal email is not encrypted
regulatory_risks.event: client data is lost or disclosed outside the organisation
regulatory_risks.impact: a personal data breach must be reported to the Dutch DPA under the GDPR and a fine may be imposed
regulatory_risks.observation: Compliance scan 2026: encryption of data at rest on removable media is required by NEN 7510-2 and expected by the AP. Bewust gelijkend op INC-2026-007: wordt samengevoegd.

regulatory_risks.objective: Declared care is supported by a valid indication and the client's care plan
regulatory_risks.cause: declaration codes are assigned manually without validation against the client's care indication or the NZa compliance rules
regulatory_risks.event: care is declared under an incorrect code or without a valid indication
regulatory_risks.impact: the NZa or insurers impose regulatory corrections and penalties
regulatory_risks.observation: Compliance scan 2026: NZa enforcement on incorrect declaration codes increased in the VVT sector.

regulatory_risks.objective: Remuneration of executives and interim managers complies with the WNT
regulatory_risks.cause: remuneration of executives and interim managers is not monitored against the statutory WNT maximum as part of compliance monitoring during the year
regulatory_risks.impact: the excess must be repaid, is disclosed as an irregularity in the annual report and triggers regulatory scrutiny
regulatory_risks.observation: Compliance scan 2026: two interim managers engaged via agencies; WNT class 4 maximum applies.

regulatory_risks.objective: Client data is processed and shared with third parties on a lawful basis
regulatory_risks.cause: the processing register and consent records for sharing client data with partner organisations are incomplete
regulatory_risks.event: client data is shared with third parties without a lawful basis or consent
regulatory_risks.impact: the organisation violates the GDPR and faces regulatory enforcement
regulatory_risks.observation: Compliance scan 2026: data sharing with 3 regional partners (GP posts, hospital) not covered by the processing register.

regulatory_risks.objective: Use of client records in the ECD is logged and monitored
regulatory_risks.cause: access logging of user activity in the ECD is not monitored
regulatory_risks.event: unauthorised viewing of client records by users is not detected
regulatory_risks.impact: privacy breaches remain undetected and NEN 7510 requirements are not met
regulatory_risks.observation: Compliance scan 2026: ECD logging is enabled but no one reviews the logs; NEN 7510 certification audit due Q4 2026.
